**About Cyvl**
 The best infrastructure is invisible. You only notice it when it fails. For decades, the people responsible for our roads, bridges and sidewalks have been asked to manage the physical world with tools that can't see it.
   

  

 Cyvl is the Physical AI company changing that. We build purpose\-built sensors, computer vision and AI that turn every drive into current data: what exists, where it is and what condition it's in. 500\+ cities and towns use our Infrastructure Intelligence Platform to direct the work and fix problems before they fail. 1 in 30 Americans drive on roads managed with Cyvl data.
   

  

 The proof isn't a dashboard. It's a smoother commute, a safer walk to school and public dollars going where they matter most.  As a Software Engineer at Cyvl, you'll build the systems that turn raw sensor data from thousands of miles of roads into the platform cities use to plan their work. You'll own features end to end, from cloud pipelines and APIs to the web app our customers log into every day. We're hiring across levels, from engineers a few years in to senior engineers ready to set technical direction. This role is based in Somerville, MA, or remote from San Francisco, CA.

* Design, build, and ship production systems across our stack: Python services, cloud data pipelines, APIs, and the Cyvl web platform.
* Own features from idea to production, working directly with product, data operations, and customers to understand the problem first.
* Build the APIs and integrations (Esri ArcGIS, Cartegraph, and more) that put Cyvl data inside the tools governments already use.

* Use AI coding tools every day to move faster, and help shape how our team builds with them.
